en: A black‑and‑white historic postcard-style image showing a tall medieval brick tower rising above low houses along a cobblestone street. The tower has Gothic brickwork, narrow arched windows, and a steep roof topped with a richly ornamented spire and flagpole. Horse‑drawn carriages and pedestrians move along the street in front of the tower, suggesting a late 19th or early 20th century scene in a European city. Awning‑covered shopfronts sit at the base of the tower, and additional historic buildings appear in the background.
